notes: API keys travel in Authorization without a scheme. Audio is uploaded to /v2/upload, a transcript submitted with its upload_url and speech_models, and polled until completed or error; audio_duration is in seconds and word times in milliseconds. DELETE /v2/transcript/{id} removes the transcript and its audio. GET /v2/transcript?limit=1 proves a key without cost. The EU region is api.eu.assemblyai.com.
